name: Semistrong Graph Product
definition: For graphs $H$ and $P$, the semistrong product has vertex set $V(H)\times V(P)$, with $(h,p)$ adjacent to $(h',p')$ exactly when $pp'\in E(P)$ and either $h=h'$ or $hh'\in E(H)$.
comments: This asymmetric product is used as a host representation; the recorded squaregraph theorem asserts ordinary subgraph containment, not induced or isometric containment.
